Spectral.Settings.Category.Description: Configuration settings for the Spectral API linter extension.
Spectral.Settings.Enable.Description: Controls whether Spectral linting is enabled for the workspace.
Spectral.Settings.RulesetFile.Descriptio: Path to the Spectral ruleset file (.spectral.yaml, .spectral.json, .spectral.yml, or .spectral.js). Leave empty to use the default ruleset in the workspace root or Spectral's built-in rules.
Spectral.Settings.RunMode.Description: Determines when Spectral linting runs: on file save or as you type.
Spectral.Settings.ValidateFiles.Descript: Glob patterns for files to validate (e.g., **/*.yaml, **/*.json). Use ! prefix for exclusions (e.g., !**/node_modules/**).
Spectral.Settings.SpectralPath.Descripti: Path to the Spectral CLI executable. Use 'spectral' if installed globally via npm, or provide a full path.
